qualification.education_qualification: Medical qualification included in I or II schedule or part II of third schedule to Indian Medical Council Act 1956 with relevant post-graduate qualification and experience.
qualification.details: Professor: A medical qualification included in the I or II schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, A postgraduate qualification e.g., MD/MS or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto. Thirteen years teaching and/or research experience for General disciplines, or ten years for Super-specialty discipline. Associate Professor: A medical qualification included in the I or II schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, A postgraduate qualification e.g., MD/MS or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto. Seven years teaching and/or research experience for General Discipline, or four years for Super-specialty disciplines. Assistant Professor: A medical qualification included in the I or II schedule or part II of the third schedule to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, A postgraduate qualification e.g., MD/MS or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto. Three years teaching and/or research experience as Senior Resident/Demonstrator/Tutor/Lecturer or equivalent for General Discipline. No experience is necessary for Super-Specialty discipline with D.M./M.Ch. Deputy Medical Superintendent (DMS): A recognized Medical Qualification included in or Part II of the Schedule or Part II of the third schedule, MD (Hospital Administration)/MHA or equivalent recognized by Medical Council of India. Nine (09) years' experience in Hospital Administration of at least 200 bedded Govt. hospital.

selection_process: Fill the online Google form before the last date. Interview based on academic qualification
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGSSH Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGSSH to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the RGSSH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 22-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of RGSSH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital (RGSSH) located in Tahirpur, Delhi, for filling various faculty and administrative positions on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in RGSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 45 vacancies available across different posts, including Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Deputy Medical Superintendent.

faq.question: Q3. What are the names of the posts offered in this recruitment drive?
faq.answer: The posts include Professor, Associate Professor, Assistant Professor, and Deputy Medical Superintendent (DMS) in various medical departments and disciplines.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for RGSSH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to fill out and submit the online Google application form is 22-10-2026. Candidates should ensure timely submission before the deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the tentative date of the interview for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The tentative date for the interview is scheduled for 28-10-2026. Applicants must bring their filled forms and original documents on this day.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Professor and Associate Professor posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Professor and Associate Professor posts is 60 years as per the guidelines laid out in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for an Assistant Professor at RGSSH?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Assistant Professor post will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 1,95,000/- per month during their contract tenure.

faq.question: Q8. What educational qualification is required for Deputy Medical Superintendent?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognized medical qualification along with an MD in Hospital Administration (MHA) or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Medical Council of India.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for RGSSH Faculty Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to apply through an online Google form provided by the hospital administration, followed by attending an interview with required documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official website of Rajiv Gandhi Super Speciality Hospital?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website of RGSSH at https://rgssh.delhi.gov.in to access the latest updates, notifications, and application link details.
